verses.1: Unto the end. A Psalm of David, in remembrance that the Lord had saved him.
verses.2: O God, reach out to help me. O Lord, hasten to assist me.
verses.3: May those who seek my soul be confounded and awed.
verses.4: May those who wish evils upon me be turned back and blush with shame. May they be turned away immediately, blushing with shame, who say to me: “Well, well.”
verses.5: Let all who seek you exult and rejoice in you, and let those who love your salvation forever say: “The Lord be magnified.”
verses.6: I am truly destitute and poor. O God, assist me. You are my helper and my deliverer. O Lord, do not delay. [ Psalm 70 ] (71)
